params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: interval
params.description: Aggregation works by giving a time range plus interval (e.g. 1d, 1h, 10m) where aggregation function would be applied to.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: page
params.description: Select the page number to return when using page-based pagination; starts at `1`
